text: The Leibniz formula expresses det(A) for an n×n matrix as a signed sum over:
choices: all pairs of rows of A
explanation: det(A) = Σ_{σ∈Sₙ} sgn(σ) ∏ᵢ A_{i,σ(i)}: each permutation picks one entry from every row and column, weighted by its sign. The n! growth is why cofactor/Leibniz evaluation is abandoned for O(n³) row reduction.
